decisions.reason: The client eliminates Big Blocks while retaining the ongoing $500 Small Block prizes; the supplied Small Block prize state remains unchanged.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey Joseph, id like to eliminate the big blocks and give that extra $1 to me, so it'll be:
$15 buy, $5 to me,  $5 to affiliate,  $5 to block prize pool.

Increases my bottom line with minimal impact on sales.
Plus it simplifies the game mechanics and marketing.

Giveing myself and each community member an even split, as well as everyone getting an even shot at the never ending $500 prizes seems aligned with the projects ethos.

decisions.reason: The remaining Small Block prizes still use the existing automatic payout and notification workflow, and the candidate state contains no Big-Block-specific claim behavior.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY setting the primary-mint prize-pool allocation to $5, and its remaining general funding attributes do not depend on Big Blocks.
Eliminating Big Blocks does not change the requirement to enforce a flat $10 royalty on secondary sales.
Random, ticket-weighted, on-chain selection remains applicable to the surviving Small Block prizes, and the candidate contains no Big-Block-specific selection attribute.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records the $5 founder share, $5 prize-pool share, and Small Block prize pool as the active pool.
The certificate and confirmation-email state contains no Big Block prize or ticket content and remains valid unchanged.
The Big Block removal does not change the deferred Transak fiat-payment provider, payment methods, or non-crypto buyer flow.
